senses.gloss: (cmp. שָׁאָה, שָׁהָה) to dwell, linger, denom. שָׁעָה.

units: Sifré Deut. 318 (ref. to Deut. XXXII, 17) אל תקרי לא שערום אלא לא שָׁעוּם וכ׳ read not lo s’ʿarum, but lo shaʿum (whom they did not regard); although they sacrificed and burnt incense to them, they were not afraid of them (with ref. to Gen. IV, 5); Yalk. ib. 945.
